title: FlowMap-OPD: Rollout--Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators
title_zh: FlowMap-OPD: 基于内核分离的少量步骤流动图生成器的离策蒸馏框架

paragraphs.en: Few-step flow-map generators, including MeanFlow and consistency models, enable efficient sampling through long-range transport, yet their on-policy distillation remains underexplored. We introduce FlowMap-OPD, an on-policy distillation framework that separates student-state acquisition from teacher–student distribution comparison. A formulation based on state marginals establishes this separation, while flow–velocity consistency connects local supervision to the deployed long-range map. Within this framework, we develop flow-map, induced-velocity, and instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision, each paired with a separately specified native flow-map rollout. Cross-capacity ImageNet experiments across three teacher rewards identify instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision with independently tunable student consistency as the most effective choice. In text-to-image experiments, FlowMap-OPD demonstrates strong multi-specialist consolidation capabilities and surpasses multi-reward Flow-Map GRPO in task performance and convergence speed.
paragraphs.zh: 少数步流图生成器（包括 MeanFlow 和一致性模型）通过长距离传输实现了高效采样，但其在策略内蒸馏方面的研究仍不足。 我们提出了 FlowMap-OPD，一种策略内蒸馏框架，它将学生状态的获取与教师-学生分布的对比分离开来。 基于状态边缘的公式实现了这种分离，而流-速度一致性则将局部监督与部署的长距离流图连接起来。 在该框架中，我们开发了流图、诱导速度和瞬时速度分布的监督机制，每种机制都配有一个独立指定的原生流图展开过程。 在三种教师奖励设置下的跨容量 ImageNet 实验中，瞬时速度分布监督结合可独立调节的学生一致性被证明是最有效的选择。 在文本到图像实验中，FlowMap-OPD 展现了强大的多专家整合能力，并在任务性能和收敛速度上超越了多奖励的 Flow-Map GRPO。

paragraphs.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student using teacher supervision on states encountered during its own generation [ 1 , 8 ] . Unlike distillation based solely on teacher-generated data, OPD reduces the mismatch between training and inference distributions by training on states drawn from the student’s own generation distribution, allowing the student to learn from its own mistakes [ 1 ] . DiffusionOPD and Flow-OPD extend this principle to diffusion and flow-matching models through local teacher–student transition-distribution comparisons [ 13 , 4 ] . These comparisons provide direct guidance throughout generation, without requiring terminal rewards or credit assignment across preceding sampling steps. Their trajectory-level formulations use the same student transition kernel for rollout and teacher comparison, coupling two distinct design choices: which states the student visits and what the teacher supervises at those states.
paragraphs.zh: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）利用教师在自身生成过程中所遇到的状态所提供的监督来训练学生智能体 [ 1 , 8 ] 。 与仅基于教师生成数据的蒸馏方法不同，OPD 通过在从学生智能体自身的生成分布中抽取的状态上进行训练，减少了训练分布与推理分布之间的不匹配，从而使学生智能体能够从自身的错误中学习 [ 1 ] 。 DiffusionOPD 和 Flow-OPD 将这一原则扩展到扩散模型和流匹配模型中，通过局部教师–学生转移分布的比较来实现 [ 13 , 4 ] 。 这些比较在整个生成过程中提供了直接指导，而无需终端奖励或在前序采样步骤中进行信用分配。 它们在轨迹层面的构建方式在展开和教师比较中使用了相同的学生转移核函数，从而将两个独立的设计选择耦合在一起：学生智能体访问哪些状态，以及教师在这些状态下对哪些内容提供监督。

paragraphs.en: Conventional diffusion and flow-matching samplers require many sequential model evaluations, making both generation and on-policy state collection costly. Flow-map generators such as MeanFlow and consistency models reduce this cost by directly predicting long-range transport in one or a few steps [ 6 , 19 , 17 ] . Yet on-policy distillation for these few-step generators remains underexplored. In MeanFlow, the same network predicts average velocities over finite intervals and instantaneous velocities on the diagonal, providing both flow-map and velocity representations. Flow–velocity consistency links these representations, suggesting that sampling and supervision need not use the same interface. This raises our central question: must a flow-map generator use the same representation for rollout and teacher–student distribution comparison, or can it collect states through long-range maps while learning through a different, consistent representation?
paragraphs.zh: 传统的扩散采样器和流匹配采样器需要多次顺序模型评估，导致生成和在线策略状态收集的成本都很高。 像 MeanFlow 和一致性模型这样的流图生成器通过直接预测一次或少数几步中的长距离传输来降低这种成本 [6, 19, 17]。 然而，针对这些少数步生成器的在线策略蒸馏仍然未被充分探索。 在 MeanFlow 中，同一网络既预测有限区间上的平均速度，也预测对角线上的瞬时速度，从而同时提供流图和速度表示。 流-速度一致性将这些表示联系起来，表明采样和监督不必使用相同的接口。 这引出了我们的核心问题：流图生成器是否必须在展开和教师-学生分布比较中使用相同的表示，或者它能否通过长距离流图收集状态，同时通过另一种一致但不同的表示进行学习？

paragraphs.en: We introduce FlowMap-OPD , a theoretical framework based on rollout–kernel separation . Starting from trajectory-level OPD, we rewrite its additive local objective as teacher–student comparisons over the joint distribution of student-generated states and comparison times. For a fixed local comparison and time weighting, the expected objective depends on these state marginals and comparison-time distributions rather than the full cross-time coupling of the rollout. This separates two roles: the rollout provides training states, while a compatible optimization kernel defines the teacher–student comparison at those states. Flow–velocity consistency then connects local velocity supervision to the long-range map used for generation. This separation is particularly natural for OPD, where teachers provide local supervision without requiring credit assignment from terminal rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 FlowMap-OPD，这是一个基于展开–核分离的理论框架。 从轨迹层面的 OPD 出发，我们将其可加的局部目标函数重写为基于学生生成状态与比较时间联合分布的教师–学生比较。 对于固定的局部比较和时间加权，期望目标函数取决于这些状态边缘分布和比较时间分布，而非展开过程中跨时间的完整耦合关系。 这分离了两种角色：展开过程提供训练状态，而一个兼容的优化核则在这些状态下定义教师–学生比较。 随后，流–速度一致性将局部速度监督与生成过程中使用的长程映射连接起来。 对于 OPD 而言，这种分离尤为自然，因为教师无需从终端奖励中分配信用，即可提供局部监督。

paragraphs.en: Our theory establishes when rollout replacement preserves the distillation objective and how flow–velocity consistency connects local supervision to the deployed flow map. Building on these results, FlowMap-OPD pairs native flow-map rollouts with flow-map [ 14 ] , induced-velocity [ 10 ] , or instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision, expanding the supervision design space for few-step flow-map generators. In the instantaneous-velocity instance, the teacher provides instantaneous-velocity targets at student-visited states, while student self-consistency connects this supervision to the long-range map used for generation. Our cross-capacity ImageNet study tests twelve configurations under each of three teacher rewards, identifying instantaneous velocity supervision with separately tunable consistency as an effective instantiation while revealing reward-dependent trade-offs. Text-to-image experiments further demonstrate strong multi-specialist consolidation in a single few-step student. Given already available specialist teachers, FlowMap-OPD surpasses multi-reward Flow-Map GRPO in task performance and convergence speed. Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的理论阐明了在何种情况下展开替换能够保持蒸馏目标，以及流–速度一致性如何将局部监督与部署的流图联系起来。 基于这些成果，FlowMap-OPD将原生流图的展开结果与流图 [ 14 ]、诱导速度 [ 10 ] 或瞬时速度分布的监督相结合，从而扩展了少步流图生成器的监督设计空间。 在瞬时速度情形中，教师模型在学生访问过的状态处提供瞬时速度目标，而学生的自一致性则将这种监督与用于生成的长程流图连接起来。 我们的跨容量 ImageNet 研究在三类教师奖励下测试了十二种配置，发现具有可单独调节一致性的瞬时速度监督是一种有效的实现方式，同时也揭示了与奖励相关的权衡关系。 文本到图像的实验进一步表明，单一少步学生模型能够有效地整合多种专家能力。 在已有可用专家教师模型的情况下，FlowMap-OPD 在任务性能和收敛速度上均优于多奖励的 Flow-Map GRPO。我们的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: The flow map ψ t → r : ℝ d → ℝ d \psi_{t\to r}:\mathbb{R}^{d}\to\mathbb{R}^{d} transports a state from time t t to time r r along the deterministic ODE, satisfying ψ t → r ​ ( x t ) = x r \psi_{t\to r}(x_{t})=x_{r} for any trajectory of d ​ x t / d ​ t = v ⁡ ( x t , t ) dx_{t}/dt=v(x_{t},t) . Equivalently, ψ t → r ​ ( x t ) = x t − ∫ r t v ⁡ ( x τ , τ ) ​ 𝑑 τ \psi_{t\to r}(x_{t})=x_{t}-\int_{r}^{t}v(x_{\tau},\tau)\,d\tau . The maps satisfy ψ t → t = Id \psi_{t\to t}=\mathrm{Id} and the composition relation ψ t → r = ψ s → r ∘ ψ t → s \psi_{t\to r}=\psi_{s\to r}\circ\psi_{t\to s} for r ≤ s ≤ t r\leq s\leq t . The flow map transports not only individual states but also their distributions: if x t ∼ p t x_{t}\sim p_{t} , then x r = ψ t → r ​ ( x t ) ∼ p r x_{r}=\psi_{t\to r}(x_{t})\sim p_{r} , giving the pushforward relation p r = ( ψ t → r ) # ​ p t p_{r}=(\psi_{t\to r})_{\#}p_{t} . Since the ODE and its marginal-preserving SDE share the same probability path, this deterministic map also represents the SDE’s time marginals through p t = ( ψ 1 → t ) # ​ p 1 p_{t}=(\psi_{1\to t})_{\#}p_{1} . Thus, even when methods such as DiffusionOPD and Flow-OPD [ 13 , 4 ] use discretized stochastic dynamics to obtain tractable transition kernels K K , the underlying continuous-time marginals can be expressed through the ODE flow map. Few-step models directly parameterize this long-range transport operator by ψ t → r θ \psi^{\theta}_{t\to r} .

paragraphs.en: Few-step flow-map generation brings together two transport representations: a flow map for long-range transport and a velocity field for instantaneous dynamics. Flow–velocity consistency links these representations, motivating the use of different, compatible transport representations for different roles in distillation. We develop this idea in three steps. Section 3 establishes how rollout and optimization kernel can be specified separately in the OPD objective. Section 4 establishes the flow–velocity consistency relations that connect these transport representations and support their use in different roles. Section 4.2 uses these relations to construct concrete supervision kernels and pair them with native MeanFlow and CM rollouts, respecting each model’s time parameterization.
paragraphs.zh: 少步流图生成将两种传输表示结合在了一起：一种用于长距离传输的流图，以及一种用于瞬时动力学的速度场。 流与速度的一致性将这些表示关联起来，因此有理由在蒸馏过程中为不同角色使用不同但兼容的传输表示。 我们将通过三个步骤来展开这一思路。 第 3 节阐明了如何在 OPD 目标函数中分别指定展开和优化核。 第 4 节建立了连接这些传输表示并支持其在不同角色中使用的流与速度一致性关系。 第 4.2 节利用这些关系构建具体的监督核，并将其与原生 MeanFlow 和 CM 展开相结合，同时尊重每个模型的时间参数化方式。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Eq. ( 8 ), regardless of how states are obtained, preserving their marginal distribution at each query time preserves the objective for a fixed local comparison and time weighting. Consequently, the rollout can be chosen for efficient state acquisition, while the optimization kernel is chosen for teacher–student comparison at those states. The two roles need not use the same transition: a flow-map rollout can supply states for a local velocity comparison, provided that it preserves the required marginals. This is the basis of rollout–kernel separation . Keeping the original comparison and matching its state marginals and time weighting recovers the original objective. Choosing a different comparison instead defines a new distillation objective within the same framework; Section 4 establishes how flow–velocity consistency connects different transport representations to the same deployed map.

paragraphs.en: By introducing long-range predictions alongside instantaneous velocities, flow-map generators naturally provide two representations of transport. paragraphs.en: Although training states can be collected through multi-step velocity integration, we use native few-step flow-map rollouts for more efficient state acquisition. We consider two classes of flow-map parameterizations: fixed-endpoint maps ψ t → 0 \psi_{t\to 0} , which vary the source time while keeping the destination fixed, and two-time maps ψ t → r \psi_{t\to r} , which allow both source and destination times to vary within 0 ≤ r ≤ t ≤ 1 0\leq r\leq t\leq 1 . We use CM and MeanFlow as representative examples, respectively, and retain their native few-step rollouts to collect training states.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管可以通过多步速度积分来收集训练状态，但我们使用原生的少数步流图展开，以实现更高效的狀態获取。 我们考虑两类流图参数化：固定终点的映射 ψ t → 0 \psi_{t\to 0}，其源时间变化而目标时间保持固定；以及双时间映射 ψ t → r \psi_{t\to r}，其源时间和目标时间均可在 0 ≤ r ≤ t ≤ 1 的范围内变化。 我们分别使用 CM 和 MeanFlow 作为代表性示例，并保留它们的原生少数步展开以收集训练状态。

paragraphs.en: Our main experiments use MeanFlow; supplementary results for CM students appear in Appendix E (Table 7 ). We first compare supervision choices on ImageNet by separately distilling MMD-, classifier-, and DINO-adapted XL/2 teachers into B/2 students. This comparison selects the velocity-supervision objective with a tunable consistency term. We then use this objective family for text-to-image specialist consolidation and study its consistency coefficient separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要实验使用了 MeanFlow；CM 学生的补充结果见附录 E（表 7）。 我们首先在 ImageNet 上比较了不同的监督方式，具体方法是将经过 MMD、分类器和 DINO 调整的 XL/2 智能体分别蒸馏为 B/2 学生。 该比较选用了带有可调一致性项的速度监督目标函数。 接着，我们使用这一系列目标函数对文本到图像的专业模型进行整合，并单独研究了其一致性系数。

paragraphs.en: We compare three supervision families by distilling XL/2 MeanFlow teachers into B/2 students with the same native rollout and number of optimization steps.

paragraphs.en: For each reward (MMD distribution matching, classifier target log-probability, or DINO cosine similarity), a student initialized from the same pretrained B/2 model distills a pre-provided teacher optimized with Flow-Map GRPO [ 14 ] . Each setting compares twelve configurations spanning stochastic and deterministic flow-map supervision, source- and destination-induced velocity, and instantaneous velocity with varying consistency weights. All use deterministic four-step rollouts and are compared at epoch 300. We evaluate 5,000 images from ImageNet classes 0–99; FID uses 2,000 held-out reference images. Appendix E gives the training and evaluation details.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每种奖励（MMD 分布匹配、分类器目标对数概率或 DINO 余弦相似度），一个由相同预训练 B/2 模型初始化的学生智能体，都会蒸馏一个通过 Flow-Map GRPO [14] 优化的预提供教师智能体。 每种设置均比较了十二种配置，涵盖随机和确定性流图监督、源端和目标端诱导的速度，以及具有不同一致性权重的瞬时速度。 所有设置均采用确定性的四步展开，并在第 300 个训练周期进行比较。 我们从 ImageNet 的 0–99 类中评估了 5,000 张图像；FID 使用了 2,000 张预留的参考图像。 附录 E 提供了训练和评估的细节。

paragraphs.en: Instantaneous velocity supervision with λ c = 0.01 \lambda_{c}=0.01 provides the strongest overall balance across the three reward settings , ranking first for MMD and classifier transfer and second for DINO (Table 1 ); Figure 5 shows training progress. It achieves MMD FID 18.23 and classifier log-probability − 0.4720 -0.4720 , improving on the base’s 22.68 and − 0.5448 -0.5448 . For DINO, its cosine similarity of 0.7811 is close to the best value, 0.7901 from destination-induced supervision, while retaining substantially higher recall (0.1160 versus 0.0225). This configuration therefore combines strong reward transfer across all three settings with better DINO coverage than the highest-reward alternative. Full metrics appear in Appendix E . We therefore use instantaneous velocity supervision with tunable consistency for text-to-image consolidation. Since large consistency weights degrade transfer, we examine this coefficient again in the text-to-image setting.
paragraphs.zh: 当 λ c = 0.01 \lambda_{c}=0.01 时，瞬时速度监督在三种奖励设置中实现了最强的整体平衡：在 MMD 和分类器迁移方面排名第一，在 DINO 方面排名第二（表 1）；图 5 展示了训练进展。 该方法实现的 MMD FID 为 18.23，分类器对数概率为 −0.4720 -0.4720，优于基础模型的 22.68 和 −0.5448 -0.5448。 对于 DINO，其余弦相似度为 0.7811，接近由目标引导监督获得的最佳值 0.7901，同时保持了显著更高的召回率（0.1160 对比 0.0225）。 因此，这种配置在所有三种设置中实现了强大的奖励迁移，并且其 DINO 覆盖范围优于最高奖励的替代方案。 完整指标见附录 E。 因此，我们采用具有可调一致性的瞬时速度监督来进行文本到图像的整合。 由于较大的一致性权重会削弱迁移效果，我们将在文本到图像设置中再次研究该系数。

sents.zh: 因此，这种配置在所有三种设置中实现了强大的奖励迁移，并且其 DINO 覆盖范围优于最高奖励的替代方案。

sents.en: We therefore use instantaneous velocity supervision with tunable consistency for text-to-image consolidation.
sents.zh: 因此，我们采用具有可调一致性的瞬时速度监督来进行文本到图像的整合。

sents.en: Since large consistency weights degrade transfer, we examine this coefficient again in the text-to-image setting.
sents.zh: 由于较大的一致性权重会削弱迁移效果，我们将在文本到图像设置中再次研究该系数。

paragraphs.en: We combine three task-specialized teachers into one native MeanFlow student: an OCR teacher, a PickScore teacher, and a GenEval teacher [ 7 , 11 ] . The base is FLUX.1-lite-8B with a pretrained MeanFlow checkpoint, using 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution and guidance 3.5. Both teachers and the student are trained with LoRA; the teachers are optimized using Flow-Map GRPO [ 14 ] . Training prompts are sampled in a 1:1:1 task ratio, with each prompt routed to its corresponding teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将三个任务专用智能体整合为一个原生 MeanFlow 学生模型：一个 OCR 智能体、一个 PickScore 智能体和一个 GenEval 智能体 [ 7 , 11 ] 。 基础模型为 FLUX.1-lite-8B，搭配预训练的 MeanFlow 检查点，使用 512 × 512 分辨率和引导系数 3.5。 所有智能体和学生模型均通过 LoRA 进行训练；各智能体则使用 Flow-Map GRPO [ 14 ] 进行优化。 训练提示以 1:1:1 的任务比例进行采样，每个提示都会被路由至其对应的智能体。

paragraphs.en: These results suggest that the pretrained student retains a degree of flow–velocity consistency during distillation even without an explicit consistency penalty. A small penalty improves teacher transfer, whereas stronger regularization further reduces the residual at the expense of transfer quality. This trend is consistent with the ImageNet results. Flow–velocity consistency connects the supervised representation to the deployed map, but a smaller residual alone does not guarantee better teacher transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，即使没有显式的连贯性惩罚项，预训练的学生模型在蒸馏过程中仍保留了一定程度的流-速度一致性。 轻微的惩罚项能提升教师模型的迁移效果，而更强的正则化则会进一步降低残差，但会牺牲迁移质量。 这一趋势与 ImageNet 的实验结果一致。 流-速度一致性将监督学习的表示与部署的地图连接起来，但仅凭较小的残差并不一定能保证更好的教师模型迁移效果。

paragraphs.en: Learning from teacher feedback on student-generated behavior has a broader history in policy distillation. Czarnecki et al. [3] analyze how different policy-distillation formulations change the optimization objective and learning behavior. For language models, GKD trains on student-generated sequences and allows different teacher–student divergences, directly addressing the mismatch between training prefixes and inference-time outputs [ 1 ] . MiniLLM minimizes reverse KL through policy-gradient optimization, with a single-step decomposition and teacher-mixed sampling to stabilize learning [ 9 ] . DistiLLM studies the related efficiency problem: it combines skew-KL losses with adaptive off-policy reuse of student-generated outputs, reducing the cost of repeatedly collecting fresh samples [ 12 ] . These works make both the sampling distribution and the comparison objective central design choices. In continuous generation, DiffusionOPD and Flow-OPD formulate teacher feedback through local conditional transitions [ 13 , 4 ] , while Any-OPD addresses heterogeneous flow-matching teachers and students by comparing decoded outputs in a shared visual representation [ 5 ] . Our focus is the additional freedom available to few-step flow-map students: their native sampler uses long-range transport, whereas teacher supervision can act on local dynamics or on a separately constructed flow-map transition. Starting from additive local OPD objectives, we characterize when rollout changes preserve the objective and establish how flow–velocity consistency connects the chosen supervision to the deployed map.
paragraphs.zh: 从学生生成的行为中通过教师反馈进行学习的做法，在策略蒸馏领域拥有更悠久的历史。Czarnecki 等人 [3] 分析了不同的策略蒸馏公式如何改变优化目标和学习行为。 对于语言模型，GKD 基于学生生成的序列进行训练，并允许教师与学生在不同方面存在差异，从而直接解决了训练前缀与推理时输出之间的不匹配问题 [1]。 MiniLLM 通过策略梯度优化最小化反向 KL 散度，采用单步分解和教师混合采样来稳定学习过程 [9]。 DistiLLM 研究了相关的效率问题：它将偏 KL 损失与学生生成输出的自适应离策略复用相结合，从而降低了重复收集新样本的成本 [12]。 这些研究都将采样分布和比较目标作为核心的设计选择。 在连续生成中，DiffusionOPD 和 Flow-OPD 通过局部条件转移来构建教师反馈 [13, 4]，而 Any-OPD 则通过在共享的视觉表示中比较解码后的输出，解决了异质流匹配的教师与学生之间的差异问题 [5]。 我们的研究重点在于少步流图学生模型所具备的额外自由度：其原生采样器使用长程传输机制，而教师监督则可以作用于局部动态或一个独立构建的流图转移上。 从可加的局部 OPD 目标出发，我们描述了展开过程的变化在何种情况下能够保持目标不变，并阐明了流-速度一致性如何将所选的监督方式与部署的流图连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Few-step flow-map methods learn long-range transport while using consistency with local dynamics to constrain it. MeanFlow distinguishes average from instantaneous velocity and derives an identity linking the two [ 6 ] ; consistency models learn endpoint predictions that agree along a transport trajectory [ 19 , 17 ] . Flow Map Matching develops Eulerian and Lagrangian characterizations of long-range flow maps, and Align Your Flow studies scalable continuous-time flow-map distillation [ 2 , 18 ] . These relationships also support post-training: MeanFlowNFT optimizes an induced instantaneous predictor while retaining average-velocity sampling, whereas Flow-Map GRPO constructs anchored stochastic transitions around long-range flow maps [ 10 , 14 ] . We bring these complementary interfaces into a common OPD formulation. Native flow-map rollout supplies the training queries, and velocity-space or flow-map kernels specify the teacher comparison. Our consistency and deployment results explain when optimization through these interfaces constrains the flow-map generator used at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 少步流图方法在实现长程传输的同时，利用与局部动力学的一致性来对其施加约束。 MeanFlow 区分了平均速度与瞬时速度，并推导出了连接两者的恒等式 [ 6 ]；一致性模型则学习沿传输轨迹保持一致的端点预测结果 [ 19 , 17 ]。 Flow Map Matching 发展了对长程流图的欧拉描述和拉格朗日描述，而 Align Your Flow 研究了可扩展的连续时间流图蒸馏方法 [ 2 , 18 ]。 这些关系也支持训练后优化：MeanFlowNFT 在保留平均速度采样的同时，优化了诱导出的瞬时预测器；而 Flow-Map GRPO 则在长程流图周围构建了锚定的随机转移 [ 10 , 14 ]。 我们将这些互补的接口整合到一个统一的 OPD 公式中。 原生流图展开提供了训练查询，而速度空间或流图核函数则定义了教师模型的对比方式。 我们的一致性分析和部署结果表明，通过这些接口进行的优化在何种情况下能够约束推理阶段使用的流图生成器。

paragraphs.en: DiffusionNFT and DMSampler explore different combinations of sampling procedures and learning objectives for diffusion reinforcement learning [ 21 , 16 ] . We develop this perspective for few-step flow-map OPD, where a teacher directly supervises the student at states produced by its rollout. Our framework separates the sampling procedure from the teacher–student comparison, allowing generation and supervision to use different compatible representations connected by flow–velocity consistency.
paragraphs.zh: DiffusionNFT 和 DMSampler 探索了扩散强化学习中采样过程与学习目标的不同组合 [21, 16]。 我们为少步流图 OPD 提出了这一视角，其中教师直接对其展开过程生成的状态进行对学生监督。 我们的框架将采样过程与师生比较分离开来，使得生成和监督可以使用不同的兼容表示，并通过流-速度一致性连接起来。

sents.en: We develop this perspective for few-step flow-map OPD, where a teacher directly supervises the student at states produced by its rollout.
sents.zh: 我们为少步流图 OPD 提出了这一视角，其中教师直接对其展开过程生成的状态进行对学生监督。

sents.zh: 我们的框架将采样过程与师生比较分离开来，使得生成和监督可以使用不同的兼容表示，并通过流-速度一致性连接起来。

paragraphs.en: We introduced FlowMap-OPD, a framework that separates student-state collection from teacher–student distribution comparison for few-step flow-map generators. This separation expands the design space of on-policy distillation: a student can retain its native flow-map rollout while learning through flow-map, induced-velocity, or instantaneous-velocity supervision. Our theory establishes when different rollouts preserve the training objective and how flow–velocity consistency connects supervision to the deployed generator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 FlowMap-OPD，这是一个将学生状态收集与师生分布比较分离的框架，适用于少步流图生成器。 这种分离扩展了在线策略蒸馏的设计空间：学生在通过流图、诱导速度或瞬时速度监督学习的同时，可以保留其固有的流图展开方式。 我们的理论阐明了不同展开方式在何种条件下能保持训练目标，以及流-速度一致性如何将监督与部署的生成器联系起来。

sents.zh: 我们的理论阐明了不同展开方式在何种条件下能保持训练目标，以及流-速度一致性如何将监督与部署的生成器联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Experiments demonstrate effective transfer across model capacities on ImageNet and consolidation of three specialist teachers into a single text-to-image student. The consolidated student matches or exceeds each specialist on its corresponding benchmark while retaining few-step generation. These results show that separating rollout from supervision provides a practical way to transfer diverse teacher capabilities to efficient flow-map students.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，该方法在 ImageNet 上实现了不同模型容量之间的有效迁移，并将三个专业教师智能体整合为一个单一的文本到图像学生智能体。 整合后的学生智能体在各自对应的基准测试中表现与每个专业智能体相当甚至更优，同时仍保留了少步生成能力。 这些结果表明，将展开过程与监督分离，为将多样化教师智能体的能力迁移到高效的流图学生智能体提供了一种实用方法。

paragraphs.en: An auxiliary comparison rule does not by itself define a Markov chain. When anchors, extra variables, or histories are needed to interpret a comparison as a transition, the declared chain state must retain them, and the query-distribution matching condition applies to that full state. Otherwise the conditional loss remains a valid local objective without the path-KL interpretation. Deterministic comparisons are treated as regression when unequal Dirac transitions would have infinite KL.

paragraphs.en: A zero nonnegative population loss yields a zero residual almost everywhere under its query distribution. To conclude a pointwise identity on a required domain, continuity of the residual and full support of that query distribution on the domain are sufficient: a nonzero value would, by continuity, yield a neighborhood with positive residual and positive query mass, contradicting zero loss. Velocity and consistency queries require their respective support conditions and positive weights. For a fixed finite grid alone, vanishing residuals at its sampled nodes do not establish the differential identities between nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 在零非负人口损失的情况下，其查询分布下几乎处处存在零残差。 要在所需域上得出逐点恒等式，残差的连续性和该查询分布在域上的完全支撑就足够了：根据连续性，任何非零值都会产生一个具有正残差和正查询质量的邻域，这与零损失相矛盾。 速度和一致性查询需要各自的支持条件以及正权重。 仅对于固定的有限网格而言，其采样节点处残差的消失并不能确立节点之间的微分恒等式。

paragraphs.en: Both models use the MeanFlow parameterization. We use three pre-provided XL/2 teachers adapted to separate rewards: maximum mean discrepancy rewards distribution matching (MMD); classifier reward maximizes the target-class log-probability under a frozen ConvNeXt-Base (Classifier); and the reward maximizes cosine similarity to the mean class feature computed from 50 real training images using frozen DINOv2-small features (DINO). Each setting tests transfer from a separately adapted teacher. We study asymmetric distillation from XL/2 teachers to B/2 students, all initialized from the same pretrained B/2 model. All 36 configurations are compared at epoch 300.
paragraphs.zh: 两种模型都使用了 MeanFlow 参数化方法。 我们使用了三种预先提供的、针对不同奖励进行了适配的 XL/2 智能体教师：最大均值差异（MMD）奖励用于匹配分布；分类器奖励通过一个冻结的 ConvNeXt-Base 模型最大化目标类别的对数概率（Classifier）；而 DINO 奖励则通过一个冻结的 DINOv2-small 特征模型，基于 50 张真实训练图像计算出的平均类别特征来最大化余弦相似度。 每种设置都测试了从单独适配的智能体教师进行迁移的效果。 我们研究了从 XL/2 智能体教师到 B/2 学生模型的非对称蒸馏过程，所有模型均初始化为同一个预训练的 B/2 模型。 全部 36 种配置在第 300 个训练周期时进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Each reward setting compares the same twelve B/2 configurations at epoch 300: velocity supervision with λ c ∈ { 0 , 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 , 10 } \lambda_{c}\in\{0,0.01,0.1,1,10\} , stochastic flow-map supervision with λ ∈ { 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 , 0.8 } \lambda\in\{0.1,0.2,0.4,0.8\} , deterministic map regression, and source- and destination-induced velocity supervision. Each epoch collects 256 trajectories and takes four updates of effective batch size 256. We use AdamW with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , gradient clipping at 1, and fresh rank-64 LoRA adapters with scaling 128. For off-diagonal queries, the destination is the native next time with probability 0.5 0.5 , otherwise uniform in ( 0 , t ) (0,t) . Following MeanFlow, the induced-source recipe uses 75 % 75\% diagonal queries; both induced recipes use adaptive weighting and stopped targets. Consistency uses the stopped-JVP update. Stochastic-map comparison uses ε = 0.01 \varepsilon=0.01 and its kernel-KL weight, with deterministic comparison when r ≤ ε r\leq\varepsilon . Squared errors are averaged over latent coordinates. Instantaneous velocity uses w v = 1 w_{v}=1 ; deterministic map regression retains the h 2 / 2 h^{2}/2 displacement scaling. Induced losses use unit outer weighting and per-sample adaptive normalization ℓ / sg ⁡ ( ℓ + 10 − 6 ) \ell/\operatorname{sg}(\ell+10^{-6}) . The stochastic-map velocity correction is detached.
paragraphs.zh: 每种奖励设置都在第 300 个周期内比较了相同的十二种 B/2 配置：速度监督（λ c ∈ { 0 , 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 , 10 } \lambda_{c}\in\{0,0.01,0.1,1,10\}）、随机流图监督（λ ∈ { 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 , 0.8 } \lambda\in\{0.1,0.2,0.4,0.8\}）、确定性映射回归，以及源点和终点诱导的速度监督。 每个周期收集 256 条轨迹，并进行四次有效批量大小为 256 的更新。 我们使用 AdamW，学习率为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，权重衰减为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，梯度裁剪阈值为 1，并使用缩放系数为 128 的全新秩为 64 的 LoRA 适配器。 对于非对角查询，以 0.5 0.5 的概率将终点设为原生下一个时刻，否则在 ( 0 , t ) (0,t) 上均匀分布。 遵循 MeanFlow 的做法，诱导源点配方使用 75 % 75\% 的对角查询；两种诱导配方均使用自适应加权法和停止目标。 一致性使用停止 JVP 更新。 随机流图比较使用 ε = 0.01 \varepsilon=0.01 及其核 KL 权重，当 r ≤ ε r\leq\varepsilon 时则进行确定性比较。 平方误差在潜在坐标上取平均。 瞬时速度使用 w v = 1 w_{v}=1；确定性映射回归保留 h 2 / 2 h^{2}/2 的位移缩放。 诱导损失使用单位外部加权法和每个样本的自适应归一化 ℓ / sg ⁡ ( ℓ + 10 − 6 ) \ell/\operatorname{sg}(\ell+10^{-6})。 随机流图的速度修正被解耦处理。

sents.en: We use AdamW with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , gradient clipping at 1, and fresh rank-64 LoRA adapters with scaling 128.
sents.zh: 我们使用 AdamW，学习率为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，权重衰减为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，梯度裁剪阈值为 1，并使用缩放系数为 128 的全新秩为 64 的 LoRA 适配器。

sents.en: For off-diagonal queries, the destination is the native next time with probability 0.5 0.5 , otherwise uniform in ( 0 , t ) (0,t) .
sents.zh: 对于非对角查询，以 0.5 0.5 的概率将终点设为原生下一个时刻，否则在 ( 0 , t ) (0,t) 上均匀分布。

sents.en: Following MeanFlow, the induced-source recipe uses 75 % 75\% diagonal queries; both induced recipes use adaptive weighting and stopped targets.
sents.zh: 遵循 MeanFlow 的做法，诱导源点配方使用 75 % 75\% 的对角查询；两种诱导配方均使用自适应加权法和停止目标。

sents.en: Consistency uses the stopped-JVP update.
sents.zh: 一致性使用停止 JVP 更新。

sents.en: Stochastic-map comparison uses ε = 0.01 \varepsilon=0.01 and its kernel-KL weight, with deterministic comparison when r ≤ ε r\leq\varepsilon .
sents.zh: 随机流图比较使用 ε = 0.01 \varepsilon=0.01 及其核 KL 权重，当 r ≤ ε r\leq\varepsilon 时则进行确定性比较。

sents.en: Squared errors are averaged over latent coordinates.
sents.zh: 平方误差在潜在坐标上取平均。

sents.en: Instantaneous velocity uses w v = 1 w_{v}=1 ; deterministic map regression retains the h 2 / 2 h^{2}/2 displacement scaling.
sents.zh: 瞬时速度使用 w v = 1 w_{v}=1；确定性映射回归保留 h 2 / 2 h^{2}/2 的位移缩放。

sents.en: Induced losses use unit outer weighting and per-sample adaptive normalization ℓ / sg ⁡ ( ℓ + 10 − 6 ) \ell/\operatorname{sg}(\ell+10^{-6}) .
sents.zh: 诱导损失使用单位外部加权法和每个样本的自适应归一化 ℓ / sg ⁡ ( ℓ + 10 − 6 ) \ell/\operatorname{sg}(\ell+10^{-6})。

sents.en: The stochastic-map velocity correction is detached.
sents.zh: 随机流图的速度修正被解耦处理。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 5,000 generated images across ImageNet classes 0–99, with 50 images per class. FID, precision and recall are computed against 2,000 real test images; a separate set of 3,000 real images is used for validation. All student main results use epoch 300. Four-step evaluation uses the native uniform grid [ 1 , 0.75 , 0.5 , 0.25 , 0 ] [1,0.75,0.5,0.25,0] . To test whether distillation gains persist when the number of sampling steps changes, we also evaluate five-step generation using linspace ⁡ ( 1 , 0.05 , 5 ) \operatorname{linspace}(1,0.05,5) followed by zero. Table 5 compares four- and five-step results; Figure 9 shows the training curves. Following the time discretization in Flow-Map GRPO [ 14 ] , we also evaluate the same frozen checkpoints at 4, 5, 8 and 16 steps using linspace ⁡ ( 1 , 0.05 , N ) \operatorname{linspace}(1,0.05,N) followed by zero.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ImageNet 的 0–99 个类别上评估了 5,000 张生成的图像，每个类别包含 50 张图像。 FID、精确率和召回率是基于 2,000 张真实测试图像计算的；另外一组 3,000 张真实图像用于验证。 所有学生模型的主要结果均使用第 300 个训练周期。 四步评估使用原生均匀网格 [ 1 , 0.75 , 0.5 , 0.25 , 0 ] [1,0.75,0.5,0.25,0] 。 为了检验当采样步数变化时蒸馏增益是否仍然存在，我们还使用 linspace ⁡ ( 1 , 0.05 , 5 ) \operatorname{linspace}(1,0.05,5) 生成五步图像，随后接零。 表 5 比较了四步和五步的结果；图 9 展示了训练曲线。 遵循 Flow-Map GRPO [ 14 ] 中的时间离散化方法，我们还使用 linspace ⁡ ( 1 , 0.05 , N ) \operatorname{linspace}(1,0.05,N) 生成 4、5、8 和 16 步的相同冻结检查点，随后接零。

sents.en: We evaluate 5,000 generated images across ImageNet classes 0–99, with 50 images per class.
sents.zh: 我们在 ImageNet 的 0–99 个类别上评估了 5,000 张生成的图像，每个类别包含 50 张图像。

sents.en: FID, precision and recall are computed against 2,000 real test images; a separate set of 3,000 real images is used for validation.

sents.en: All student main results use epoch 300.

sents.en: Four-step evaluation uses the native uniform grid [ 1 , 0.75 , 0.5 , 0.25 , 0 ] [1,0.75,0.5,0.25,0] .

To test whether distillation gains persist when the number of sampling steps changes, we also evaluate five-step generation using linspace ⁡ ( 1 , 0.05 , 5 ) \operatorname{linspace}(1,0.05,5) followed by zero.
sents.zh: 为了检验当采样步数变化时蒸馏增益是否仍然存在，我们还使用 linspace ⁡ ( 1 , 0.05 , 5 ) \operatorname{linspace}(1,0.05,5) 生成五步图像，随后接零。

sents.en: Table 5 compares four- and five-step results; Figure 9 shows the training curves.
sents.zh: 表 5 比较了四步和五步的结果；图 9 展示了训练曲线。

sents.en: Following the time discretization in Flow-Map GRPO [ 14 ] , we also evaluate the same frozen checkpoints at 4, 5, 8 and 16 steps using linspace ⁡ ( 1 , 0.05 , N ) \operatorname{linspace}(1,0.05,N) followed by zero.
sents.zh: 遵循 Flow-Map GRPO [ 14 ] 中的时间离散化方法，我们还使用 linspace ⁡ ( 1 , 0.05 , N ) \operatorname{linspace}(1,0.05,N) 生成 4、5、8 和 16 步的相同冻结检查点，随后接零。

paragraphs.en: We additionally apply FlowMap-OPD to a fixed-endpoint CM parameterization, distilling an MMD-adapted XL/2 teacher into a B/2 student. Table 7 compares endpoint-map and source-induced velocity supervision at epoch 150. Source-induced supervision achieves the lowest FID among the compared recipes under both four- and five-step generation, supporting the use of FlowMap-OPD with CM students as well as two-time flow-map students.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将 FlowMap-OPD 应用于固定终点的 CM 参数化方法，将经过 MMD 适配的 XL/2 教师模型提炼为 B/2 学生模型。 表 7 比较了第 150 个训练周期下终点映射与源诱导速度监督的效果。 在四步和五步生成两种情况下，源诱导监督在所有对比方案中实现了最低的 FID，这支持将 FlowMap-OPD 与 CM 学生模型以及双时间流图学生模型结合使用。

sents.en: We additionally apply FlowMap-OPD to a fixed-endpoint CM parameterization, distilling an MMD-adapted XL/2 teacher into a B/2 student.
sents.zh: 我们还将 FlowMap-OPD 应用于固定终点的 CM 参数化方法，将经过 MMD 适配的 XL/2 教师模型提炼为 B/2 学生模型。

sents.en: Table 7 compares endpoint-map and source-induced velocity supervision at epoch 150.
sents.zh: 表 7 比较了第 150 个训练周期下终点映射与源诱导速度监督的效果。

sents.en: Source-induced supervision achieves the lowest FID among the compared recipes under both four- and five-step generation, supporting the use of FlowMap-OPD with CM students as well as two-time flow-map students.
sents.zh: 在四步和五步生成两种情况下，源诱导监督在所有对比方案中实现了最低的 FID，这支持将 FlowMap-OPD 与 CM 学生模型以及双时间流图学生模型结合使用。

paragraphs.en: We vary λ c \lambda_{c} and compare the students after 200 training steps. Table 8 reports student consistency and teacher-matching errors. A stronger penalty reduces the consistency residual, but large weights increase the difference from the teacher and reduce task performance (Table 3 ). The coefficient therefore controls how strongly the student fits the teacher relative to its own consistency constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 我们改变 λ c \lambda_{c}，并在 200 个训练步骤后比较学生模型。 表 8 报告了学生模型的一致性和教师匹配误差。 更强的惩罚会降低一致性残差，但较大的权重会增加与教师的差异并降低任务表现（表 3）。 因此，该系数控制着学生模型相对于其自身一致性约束，在多大程度上拟合教师模型。

sents.en: We vary λ c \lambda_{c} and compare the students after 200 training steps.
sents.zh: 我们改变 λ c \lambda_{c}，并在 200 个训练步骤后比较学生模型。

sents.en: Table 8 reports student consistency and teacher-matching errors.
sents.zh: 表 8 报告了学生模型的一致性和教师匹配误差。

sents.en: A stronger penalty reduces the consistency residual, but large weights increase the difference from the teacher and reduce task performance (Table 3 ).
sents.zh: 更强的惩罚会降低一致性残差，但较大的权重会增加与教师的差异并降低任务表现（表 3）。

sents.en: The coefficient therefore controls how strongly the student fits the teacher relative to its own consistency constraint.
sents.zh: 因此，该系数控制着学生模型相对于其自身一致性约束，在多大程度上拟合教师模型。
